abstract: AIM: To investigate an apparent cluster of four testicular cancer cases in Wellington fire fighters with a view to determining whether there was a common causal factor, and whether the cluster was indicative of an occupational risk for fire fighters generally. METHOD: Subjects were interviewed about possible risk factors and occupational histories using a structured questionnaire; medical records were reviewed, and diagnoses were verified from the original histological slides. Data on testicular cancer in fire fighters were obtained from the New Zealand cancer registry. Standardised incidence ratios were calculated to assess the likelihood that the cluster had arisen by chance. RESULTS: All four cancers were verified as germ cell testicular cancers. No common risk factors were apparent from the review of the medical records or from the questionnaire interviews. The only testicular cancers known to have occurred in Wellington fire fighters in the 1980s were the four investigated in this study. Only two of the four cases investigated were registered with the New Zealand cancer registry. The relative risk estimate for Wellington fire fighters for the period 1980-91 was 8.2, with an approximate 95% confidence interval of 2.2-21 (p = 0.002). CONCLUSION: There was an unusually high risk of testicular cancer in Wellington fire fighters in the 1980s, with no obvious explanations, although chance could not be excluded. Whether this high risk continues in the 1990s would require a separate investigation. At present the weight of evidence does not indicate that fire fighters in other areas of New Zealand also experienced an elevated testicular cancer incidence rate.

目的：ウェリントンの消防士において精巣がん4例の集積がみられたため、共通の原因因子があるか、またこの集積が消防士全体の職業的リスクを示すかを検討すること。
方法：対象者には構造化された質問票を用いて危険因子と職歴について面接を行った。診療記録を確認し、診断は元の組織学的標本から検証した。ニュージーランドのがん登録から消防士の精巣がんのデータを取得した。標準化発生比を算出し、集積が偶然に生じた可能性を評価した。
結果：4例すべてが精巣胚細胞腫瘍と確認された。診療記録と面接のいずれからも共通のリスク因子は認められなかった。調査された4例のうち、ニュージーランドのがん登録に登録されていたのは2例のみであった。1980〜91年のウェリントン消防士の相対リスク推定値は8.2であり、95%信頼区間は2.2〜21（p=0.002）であった。
結論：1980年代のウェリントン消防士では精巣がんのリスクが異常に高かったが、明らかな説明はなく、偶然の可能性も除外できない。1990年代においてこの高リスクが続くかどうかは別途調査が必要である。現時点では、ニュージーランドの他地域の消防士でも発生率が上昇していたことを示す十分な根拠はない。
